mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal impairment, which increase bleeding risk with enoxaparin, and both drugs may have additive anticoagulant effects.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and coagulation parameters closely; adjust enoxaparin dosing based on renal function and clinical bleeding assessment; consider alternative anticoagulation if feasible.
